Tg.bar_b_note: Warm saturated grass and a big readable armoured badger help, but flat white cotton-ball puff trails, a carpet of uniform grass, no sky or atmospheric depth, and (B f01-f03) a camera buried in the fence sink it.

Nz.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with readable eyes, white hair silhouette and an earthy green/brown outfit that sits at the finish of a shipping creature-collector's human NPCs, though his rounded cartoon face is softer than the naturalistic creatures.

Ly.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, diagonal brace, shingled cap and stone footing finally read as built, but the flat untextured beige infill, a lone free-standing panel, a low-poly grey boulder and a painted-card mountain backdrop keep it well below Palworld base-building finish.

Dj.bar_b_note: Close tight framing on a uniform dark-green grass carpet with no horizon, white puff blobs over the boar (f02-f04) and fence posts filling the lens (A f13, B f12-f13) read as a prototype, not a finished field fight.

Gj.bar_b_note: A's wider f26-f31 hillside, stream and arena give some place, but the white bead-chain VFX (A f21-f23, B f22-f24) hides the boar entirely and B f25-f32 has a wooden post and red banner blocking the right third of the frame.

Ul.bar_b_note: B's side-on hillside with stream, trees and arena reads as a place and the badger rears in f29-f32, but the 'Mudsnout stagger' label (B f24-f25) over an unchanged boar pose, ring-shaped white puff spirals (A f17, A f25-f27) and no sky or light shafts keep it short.

Vg.bar_b_note: A bulky armoured boar that clears the 1.80 m ruler with grounded faint poses, but its plates and fur collapse into one dark mid-to-low value (B) or red-brown glow seams that hide the tusks (A), and both go near-black and burnt at faint end, short of the style bar's rim-lit fur.

Cw.bar_b_note: A's deep blue-grey panel with large wrapped recipe text and white Craft/Leave hints is readable at both resolutions, but the hints use tiny keyboard glyphs with no teal accent, and B's truncated 'have 0), 3 St...' lines and grey 'Craft: A / Enter' footnote are unreadable on a small screen.

top_changes.change: Author additive hit-flinch, recoil and stagger poses for the badger and boar and drive them on every impact (Tg/Dj/Gj/Ul show impact bursts and a 'stagger' label over an unchanged idle body)

Replace the flat white cotton-ball puff and bead-chain trails with small dust, stone and spark impacts, and add camera collision and fade so arena posts and banners never fill the lens; frame fights wider so some sky and distance show
Give the homestead wall infill a textured wattle/daub or plank material in a mid value and keep the A-side craft panel's text scale at 720p with controller-glyph hints in teal
